description: Fetch bounded authoring context for a media item: dimensions/thumbnail, compact face roster, transcript counts/sample, temporal grids, and fact readiness. Transcript and word-grid counts cover one page only (default 20 utterances); pass transcript.data.pagination.nextCursor as after to get_media_context for the next context page, or use get_transcript for exact paginated word timings.

limit.description: Transcript utterances per context page (default 20, maximum 100).

projectId.description: Read the item through this project, for media shared into it.

name: get_media_context

audioRole.description: DECLARED audio role of this asset (audio-substrate P0): 'vo' (narration), 'music' (bed that ducks under speech), 'sfx' (one-shot hit), 'ambience' (a bed that HOLDS under VO — never ducks). Author the clip source's `audioRole` from this. Null for footage/images or an undeclared audio asset.

beatGrid.description: The MUSIC-role rhythm grid (audio-substrate MVP). Present only for a music bed that carries a computed beat grid; null otherwise. For a music-driven film, cut on these beats (transition midpoints on beats, risers resolving on downbeats).

envelope.description: Envelope evidence (audio-substrate P0). `envelopeClass` is always present when an envelope exists (the SFX pack carries it); the numeric probe stats are present only when an audio probe has run. Null when no envelope is stored.

facts.description: Derived facts about this source (subject tracks, mattes): what has been computed, its status, and what it was billed. Same shape as GET /media/{id}/facts.

offers.description: Enhancements this source does not have yet, with a server quote. Same shape as GET /media/{id}/facts. Mattes are quoted per-window via POST /media/{id}/matte, never here.

thumbnail.description: Presigned processing thumbnail (~1 week) — the footage at a glance. For stills at chosen timestamps, use preview_frame with a one-clip composition over this media.

wordGrid.description: The VO-role rhythm grid for this bounded transcript page. Present when a transcript exists; null otherwise. Check pagination.hasMore before treating it as a complete voice spine.

title: Get Media Context
